metadata.title: AutomatedLab.Common
metadata.description: The module collects all helper functions used in but not limited to AutomatedLab
metadata.authors: Raimund Andree Per Pedersen Jan-Hendrik Peters

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00002.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
